title: Marks & Percentage Calculator
description: Calculate total marks, percentage and performance.
intro: Calculate totals and percentages from marks you enter. Use a single maximum mark for every subject, or provide a matching maximum for each subject.
steps: Enter marks obtained and their maximum values, then calculate. Check the values before using results for official records.

title: CGPA / GPA Calculator
description: Calculate a credit-weighted grade point average.
intro: Get a weighted CGPA/GPA estimate from subject grade points and credits. Different institutions use different conversion rules, so enter values using your institution’s grading scale.
steps: Enter grade points and credits in matching comma-separated lists. The calculator uses a weighted average.

title: Study Timetable Maker
description: Create a simple study schedule from your subjects.
intro: Turn a list of subjects into a practical study timetable. The generated plan is a starting point; adjust it for breaks, exam dates and the subjects you find hardest.
steps: Add subjects, daily study time and a start time, then generate a schedule you can copy.

title: Flashcard Maker
description: Build and review your own question-and-answer cards.
intro: Create a local flashcard deck for revision. Cards stay in the current browser session and are not sent to a server. AI card generation can be enabled after the secure AI backend is configured.
steps: Add a question and answer, then flip through your cards to revise.

title: Quiz & Practice Question Generator
description: Generate practice questions with a connected AI provider.
intro: This tool uses an AI backend to generate questions. The website package includes the interface and secure API route, but AI generation will remain unavailable until you configure provider secrets.
steps: Enter a topic and difficulty. After API setup, the tool can request a practice quiz.

title: Age & Date Difference Calculator
description: Find age or the duration between two dates.
intro: Calculate the duration between two calendar dates using your browser. Results are informational and not a substitute for legal age verification.
steps: Select the start and end dates, then calculate the difference.

title: Case Converter
description: Convert text into uppercase, lowercase, title case and more.
intro: Quickly change text case without uploading it. Processing happens in your browser.
steps: Paste text, choose a case style and copy the result.

title: Text Animation Studio
description: Preview animated text styles and export reusable CSS locally.
intro: Design animated headings and short text snippets with a live preview. Effects are previewed locally and CSS can be copied or downloaded.
steps: Enter text, choose an animation and color, tune duration, then copy or download the CSS.

title: Language Translator
description: Translate text with a configured AI provider.
intro: Translation requires a configured language-capable AI provider. Until a provider is connected, this page clearly reports that the AI service is not configured and will not invent a translation.
steps: Enter text and the target language. Once the backend is configured, the request is processed by your chosen provider.

title: Text-to-Speech
description: Read text aloud with your browser’s speech engine.
intro: Use the speech synthesis engine provided by your browser and operating system. Available languages and voices vary by device.
steps: Paste text, choose a voice if available and press Speak.

title: YouTube Title Generator
description: Generate title ideas with a connected AI provider.
intro: Title suggestions are generated by an AI provider when configured. Until then, the tool does not claim to produce AI results.
steps: Describe your video, audience and preferred tone to request title ideas after setup.

title: YouTube Description Generator
description: Draft a video description with AI after setup.
intro: A useful video description should accurately describe the actual video, include relevant context and avoid misleading claims. AI drafting requires a configured provider.
steps: Enter a video topic and key points, then request a draft once the backend is enabled.

title: YouTube Tags Generator
description: Create relevant tag ideas from your video topic.
intro: Tag recommendations require a configured AI provider. Choose terms that honestly represent your content; unrelated tags can mislead viewers.
steps: Enter the video topic and optionally the audience or language.

title: YouTube Shorts Script Writer
description: Plan a short video script with a clear hook and ending.
intro: A good Shorts script usually opens with a clear hook, delivers one idea and ends with a concise payoff. AI drafting needs the backend provider configured.
steps: Describe the subject, duration and language to request a script.

title: Thumbnail Text & Hook Ideas
description: Brainstorm concise thumbnail text and opening hooks.
intro: Thumbnail copy should be readable, accurate and aligned with the actual video. AI suggestions require a configured provider.
steps: Describe the video’s main promise and audience to request ideas.

title: Hashtag Generator
description: Turn topic keywords into clean hashtag ideas.
intro: Create draft hashtags from keywords in your text. Always review relevance and platform guidelines before posting.
steps: Enter a topic or caption and generate a keyword-based hashtag list.

title: Instagram Caption Generator
description: Draft captions using AI when configured.
intro: Caption drafting requires a configured AI provider. Do not present generated claims, endorsements or personal experiences as facts unless they are accurate.
steps: Enter the post subject, audience and tone.

title: Social Media Bio Generator
description: Draft short profile bios with a connected AI provider.
intro: Bio suggestions require a configured AI provider. Keep profile claims accurate and within each platform’s character limit.
steps: Enter your niche, audience and a few true details about yourself or your brand.

title: Image Compressor
description: Reduce image file size in your browser.
intro: Compress JPG, PNG or WebP images by resizing and adjusting output quality in your browser. Results depend on the original file and browser support.
steps: Choose an image, set maximum dimensions and quality, then download the compressed copy.

title: Image Resizer & Cropper
description: Resize images to a target size or fit mode.
intro: Resize images locally with contain, cover-crop or stretch options. The source image remains unchanged.
steps: Choose an image, enter dimensions and select a fit mode.

title: Image Background Remover
description: Remove image backgrounds using a configured API.
intro: Background removal usually needs a dedicated segmentation model or external service and may incur costs. This starter does not upload your image or claim to remove its background until you configure an endpoint.
steps: Review your provider’s privacy and cost terms before sending images to an external service.

title: Color Picker & Palette Generator
description: Choose a color and make a matching palette.
intro: Pick a base color and view complementary, triadic and related colors. Copy individual hex values for design work.
steps: Pick a color or enter a hex code to generate a palette.

title: QR Code Generator
description: Create a QR code for a link or short text.
intro: Create a QR code from text or a URL. Verify the QR code with your phone before printing or sharing it.
steps: Enter text or a URL, generate the code and download the PNG.

title: Image to PDF Converter
description: Place an image into a downloadable PDF file.
intro: Convert an image to a single-page PDF in your browser using a bundled public library loaded from a CDN. Do not upload confidential images unless you trust the environment and libraries you use.
steps: Choose an image and export a PDF. A working internet connection is required to load the PDF library.

title: PDF Merge / Split
description: Merge PDF files or extract selected pages.
intro: Merge multiple PDFs or split selected pages using a browser-side PDF library delivered through a CDN. Files are processed locally by the library in your browser.
steps: Choose merge or split, select PDF files and follow the page selection instructions.

title: Image Format Converter
description: Convert images between supported browser formats.
intro: Convert common raster images to PNG, JPEG or WebP using the browser canvas. Some formats or transparency may behave differently across browsers.
steps: Choose an image, pick an output format and download the result.

title: JSON Formatter & Validator
description: Format, minify and validate JSON.
intro: Validate JSON syntax, pretty-print structured data or minify it. Invalid JSON produces an error message. Processing happens locally in your browser.
steps: Paste JSON and choose Format or Minify.

title: HTML / CSS / JS Formatter
description: Apply basic indentation to HTML, CSS or JavaScript snippets.
intro: This browser-based formatter performs basic indentation for pasted snippets; it is not a full language parser and may not preserve every edge case. For production code, use a dedicated formatter and review the output.
steps: Paste a snippet, choose the language and format. Always inspect code after formatting.

title: MODEL AI Chat
description: A ChatGPT-style interface powered by your configured provider.
intro: This chat UI calls a server-side API route. Add your provider key as a Cloudflare secret before using it; never put API keys in frontend files or GitHub.
steps: Configure AI_API_BASE_URL, AI_API_KEY and AI_CHAT_MODEL in Cloudflare Pages Functions secrets.

title: Image Upload & AI Analysis
description: Ask questions about an image with a vision-capable model.
intro: Image analysis requires a vision-capable model configured behind the secure API route. Images are converted to a data URL in the browser and sent only after you press Analyze.
steps: Configure a vision-capable model and review provider privacy/retention terms before use.

title: AI Coding Assistant
description: Ask a configured AI provider to explain or draft code.
intro: The coding assistant uses the same secure backend as chat. Review generated code carefully; do not run untrusted code without understanding it.
steps: Enter your coding question and specify language, constraints and expected output.

title: AI Story & Script Writer
description: Create a story or script using your configured provider.
intro: Story generation is available after secure AI provider setup. Do not treat generated factual claims as verified without checking them.
steps: Enter the story idea, language, characters and approximate duration.

title: AI Prompt Builder
description: Compose a structured prompt from goal, role, style and constraints.
intro: Build a reusable prompt from fields. This is a local template builder, not an AI model; it works without an API key.
steps: Fill in the role, task, context, tone and output format, then build and copy the prompt.

title: Logo & Image Prompt Generator
description: Create a detailed image-generation prompt template.
intro: Build an image prompt template with subject, visual style, palette and aspect ratio. It generates prompt text locally and does not create an image.
steps: Describe your subject, select a style and copy the resulting prompt into an image generator.

title: AI Image Generator
description: Create images from text prompts with a connected image-generation provider.
intro: Image generation needs a dedicated image-generation service and secure server-side credentials. This starter includes the interface but does not claim to generate images until a provider endpoint is configured.
steps: Describe the image, select an aspect ratio and style, then connect an image-generation provider before generating.
